William Norris III 1799 William Rutledge 6218'), no precinct numbers and no county file links. County site still HTTP 403; not worked around. Sweep pending. Tried: (1) wayback-data re-read at start and finish: only phase1/wayback_snapshots/Wichita/index.json (zero election-night captures); no targeted/archives, targeted/wayback, or targeted/sweep folder for Wichita (sweep pending). (2) The county site is WordPress, but wp-json media and rest_route media were already HTTP 403 (orchestrator); the site is not on newtools.cira.state.tx.us (no Wichita links found there); not worked around. (3) Check 4: KAUZ 2024 general story 'Wichita Falls, Wichita County election results' (https://www.newschannel6now.com/2024/11/06/wichita-falls-wichita-county-election-results/, datePublished 2024-11-06T01:34:01.905Z, 7:34 PM CST) lists totals only, e.g. 'Precinct 3: Barry Mahler (R) - 6,094 Deandra M. Chenault (D) - 2,537' (commissioner precinct, not voting precincts) and 'Election vote totals are all in, but will not be official until certified.'; no per-precinct votes. KAUZ 2022 story (lead for host only) also totals only. Two Times Record News stories syndicated on aol.com (judge runoff, sheriff) returned HTTP 404. Six web searches (recorded) found no vendor ENR site, no county file on another host, and no third-party per-precinct candidate votes for any of the three elections. Targeted pass 6 2026-10-03 (targeted6-D): no election changed. New lead from the archive sweep (wayback_branch, phase1/targeted/sweep/Wichita): the county's WordPress sitemap of 'election_stats' posts (one post per race), archived 20241120213038 (sha256 0cfcefd5), lists 37 race posts with lastmod between 2024-11-05T22:04:45-06:00 and 2024-11-05T22:40:07-06:00 (e.g. 'https://wichitacountytx.com/election_stats/president-vice-president/ 2024-11-05T22:31:53-06:00'); the same sitemap archived 20260323081712 lists the 2026 primary race posts with lastmod 2026-03-03T21:53:42-06:00 to 2026-03-03T22:47:50-06:00 (e.g. 'https://wichitacountytx.com/election_stats/county-judge-republican-party/ 2026-03-03T21:58:39-06:00'), plus six 15th Court of Appeals posts modified 2026-03-04 08:09 to 08:15; the 2024 posts no longer appear there. So the county edited a per-race results post for every race on both election nights and did not edit them again before the captures, but the post contents (county totals only, or per-precinct numbers) are not saved anywhere readable here; the archived copies requested by pdf-probe run 4 (phase1/targeted/pdfs) had not landed when this pass finished (run still pending), so neither LATER nor END can be decided. No runoff capture of the sitemap exists in the sweep. Check 4 (third parties): five web searches (recorded) found no Wichita County Republican or Democratic party website and no GitHub or civic scrape; KAUZ 2026 primary story (refetched, hash f188d1a1, datePublished 2026-03-04T00:47:40Z) and KAUZ 'Brooks defeats Barron for City Council District 2' (hash e4a12a89, 10:40 PM CST Nov 5 2024, 'Out of reported results so far, Brooks has accumulated 1,791 to Barron's 1,157 votes') give totals only; 929nin.com 'Election Night Results' is from 2014 (hash fbfef1fb) and its wp-json returns 404; The Wichitan article (hash 07824902) is 2020 totals. County site not requested (bot protection). Lead for later: read the election_stats post copies when pdf-probe run 4 lands; a copy showing only county totals would need the rule 43 test, a copy showing per-precinct candidate votes the rule 47 test (sitemap lastmod is a server-side modification time, not a printed time).
